problem: The built-in RenderFrameCache certifies changed entity poses, but temporal GPU batches still queried current and previous models for every member on every frame, including unchanged records.

change.behavior: Stable temporal batches visit certified current changes and the preceding unsettled records. A stopped object's previous model catches up on its next admitted render observation. Work is keyed by RuntimeEntity identity and validated against the current ID-to-slot generation.
change.lifetime: Reusable pending, next and visited sets are bounded by current batch membership, discard stale generations after regrouping, and clear on scene swap, history reset and preparation/disposal cleanup.
change.preserved: Full end-of-frame history commits, independent camera/reflection/shadow visibility, compact non-temporal updates, rendered geometry, shader math and GPU quality settings.

oracle.referenceOrigin: Frozen built prepareCameraBatches immediately before this optimization
oracle.comparison: Exact live current/previous/color/weather buffer bytes and exact uploaded byte ranges and contents across both 160-byte temporal and 96-byte compact records
coverage: replacement under the same ID while unsettled
oracle.additionalFailureCase: An injected GPU upload exception forces a full fallback with current=current previous model before incremental updates resume.

limits: Model lookup counts establish removed bookkeeping in this regression workload. They do not measure saved wall time or establish canonical game FPS. Fixed-quality live measurements are separate.
